newsitem.title: USA: NYC gets $158 mln in retail orders for its bonds.
newsitem.headline: NYC gets $158 mln in retail orders for its bonds.

text.p: New York City got a total of $158 million of orders from individual investors, about 25 percent of the total of $626 million that it plans to sell on Tuesday, a New York City official said on Monday.
Only two maturities, 1998 and 1999 were closed, and the city official, who declined to be named, attributed the slightly lower level of interest to last week's volatile market conditions.
Another factor that might have dampened interest was the sale of $677 million of bonds last Wednesday by the Municipal Assistance Corp for New York City.
